content:
Phase A complete. Results:
- String xref recovery: 30 new xrefs (most already found by Ghidra). ~2700 strings remain orphaned (dead code or table-accessed).
- InferPrintf: 20 printf signatures applied (same as before — no new ones from xref recovery)
- SmartRename: 1,218 functions renamed across 18 programs via SVC ID matching + string pattern matching
- Pattern analysis: 550-line report captured for 5 key programs (PSP_FW_BOOT_LOADER, ABL5, ABL6, ABL1, PSP_FW_TRUSTED_OS)
